resources.string: No app here can pick files
Encrypted, password-protected storage on this phone
Files you add are encrypted on this phone, names included. Opening them takes your password or recovery key. There\'s no account and no server.
There\'s no account to reset your password from. In the last step you\'ll get a recovery key instead: if you forget your password, it\'s the only way back in.
Your files are encrypted, so without your password or your recovery key, no one can open them. That includes Kobblo.
Backups and phone transfers leave your vault behind. Move your files out before you switch phones.
Choose a master password and hint. You will need this to unlock your vault.
